RawExpression: There is a playground. We often play there.
RawTranslation: 那里有个游乐场。我们经常在那里玩儿。
这里有一个太极拳俱乐部。
太棒了！我们一起做运动吧。

RawExpression: Sure. Let's go to the clothes shop.
You already have too many shorts. Let's buy trousers.
RawTranslation: 你已经有很多短裤了。我们买长裤吧。

RawExpression: Let's draw some purple and brown birds.
RawTranslation: 我们一起画一些紫色和棕色的鸟吧。

RawExpression: Great! Let's go to the shop!
RawTranslation: 好极了！我们一起去商店吧！

RawExpression: Hi, Mark! This is John. What's the weather like in Sydney?
RawTranslation: 嗨，马克！我是约翰。悉尼的天气怎么样？

RawExpression: Can I wear this new shirt today?
RawTranslation: 我今天可以穿这件新衬衫吗？

RawExpression: Can I buy a new pair?
Can I use your eraser, please?
RawTranslation: 我能用一下你的橡皮吗？

RawExpression: Can you please pass me the vegetables?
RawTranslation: 能否请你把蔬菜递给我？

RawExpression: Mike, Amy, would you like a knife and fork?
RawTranslation: 迈克、埃米，你们需要餐刀和餐叉吗？

RawExpression: Would you like some rice and meat?
Our neighbour is a firefighter. He often helps people.
RawTranslation: 我们的邻居是消防员。他经常帮助别人。

RawExpression: He's a school bus driver. He takes us to school every day.
RawTranslation: 他是校车司机。他每天送我们去学校。

RawExpression: I like winter too. There are many festivals.
RawTranslation: 我也喜欢冬天。（在冬天）有很多节日。

RawExpression: My favourite place is the museum.
RawTranslation: 我最喜欢的地方是博物馆。

RawExpression: Chen Jie is making the bed.
In the kindergarten, John and Class One are singing songs together.
RawTranslation: 在幼儿园，约翰和一班（的小朋友们）在一起唱歌。

RawExpression: Yes, but wear a coat too. It's cold and windy outside.
RawTranslation: 可以，但是再穿一件外套吧。外面有风，很冷。

RawExpression: Yes. I like this pink dress.
RawTranslation: 嗯。我喜欢这件粉色的长裙。

RawExpression: What can we do for them?
RawTranslation: 我们能为他们做些什么？
我们可以做一些家务活。

RawExpression: It's OK. We can go to the library.
RawTranslation: 没关系。我们可以去图书馆。

RawExpression: No. You have to do your homework first.

RawTranslation: 对不起，请再说一次可以吗？

RawExpression: Be careful, Jack. Don't touch hot things.
RawTranslation: 杰克，要小心。别碰烫的东西。

RawExpression: Hurry up! Don't be late for class!
Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.
I'd like some bread and eggs, please.
RawTranslation: 我想吃点儿面包和鸡蛋。

RawExpression: Mum, where is my animal book?
RawTranslation: 妈妈，我的动物书在哪儿？

RawExpression: How many books do we have?
How many boxes do we need?
How about three for sixteen yuan?
What can you do for the festival?
RawTranslation: 你能为科学艺术节做什么？
萨拉，你能制作机器人吗？

RawExpression: Hi, Mike. You look sad. What's the matter?
RawTranslation: 嗨，迈克。你看起来不开心。怎么回事？
是关于我们学校的项目。

RawExpression: And we have to finish our project by Monday.
RawTranslation: 并且我们得在星期一之前完成项目。

RawExpression: So you don't agree with each other?

RawTranslation: 为什么不两个活动都做呢？

RawExpression: It's important to listen to each other.
RawTranslation: 听取彼此的想法很重要。

RawExpression: Yes, Miss White. I need to talk to Mike.
RawTranslation: 是的，怀特老师。我需要和迈克谈谈。

RawExpression: What’s your favourite day at school, John?
RawTranslation: 你在学校最喜欢哪一天，约翰？

RawExpression: What do you have on Wednesdays?
I have Chinese, maths, music and PE.
RawTranslation: 我有语文课、数学课、音乐课和体育课。

RawExpression: What do you usually do at the weekend, children?
RawTranslation: 孩子们，周末你们通常做什么？

RawExpression: I often play football. Sometimes I play Chinese chess with my father.
RawTranslation: 我经常踢足球。有时我和爸爸下象棋。

RawExpression: Does your mother work on both Saturdays and Sundays?
RawTranslation: 你妈妈周六周日都工作吗？
是的，她（周末两天）都工作。

RawExpression: How can we all stay healthy?
RawTranslation: 我们怎样才能保持健康？
我们应该吃健康的食物。

RawExpression: Can I play on Mum's phone?
RawTranslation: 我可以玩妈妈的手机吗？

RawExpression: No. You shouldn't play on a phone so often.
RawTranslation: 不行。你不应该总玩手机。

RawExpression: What would you like to eat?
Would you like some chicken soup too?
Where does your coconut come from?
There are also many rivers in the nature park.
RawTranslation: 这个自然公园还有许多河流。

RawExpression: Is there a waterfall in the forest?
Are there any famous mountains in the nature park?
There will be heavy rain in the afternoon too.
When do you finish class in the morning?
RawTranslation: 你们上午的课到几点结束？
我们一点钟结束上午的课。

RawExpression: What do you do on the weekend?
I often watch TV and play ping-pong with my father.
RawTranslation: 我经常看电视，也常和爸爸一起打乒乓球。

RawExpression: Which season do you like best, Miss White?
RawTranslation: 怀特小姐，你最喜欢哪个季节？

RawExpression: When is the trip this year?
RawTranslation: 今年的（秋）游在什么时候？

RawExpression: It's in October. We'll go to the Great Wall.
It was great! I climbed the Great Wall.
I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
RawTranslation: 我上个星期六参观“姜饼屋”了。

RawExpression: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?
I went to Xi'an with my family.

RawTranslation: 你们在那里做了些什么？

RawExpression: We went to see the Terracotta Warriors.
How was your Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, Binbin?
RawTranslation: 你中秋假期过得怎么样，斌斌？

RawExpression: My mother and I went to a marathon on Sunday.
RawTranslation: 我和妈妈上周日去看了一场马拉松比赛。

RawExpression: What did you like about it?
What did you do last weekend?
I feel ill. My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
RawTranslation: 我感觉不舒服。我头疼还流鼻涕。

RawExpression: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you should see a doctor.
RawTranslation: 对此我感到难过。也许你应该去看医生。

RawExpression: How can we live a healthy life?
RawTranslation: 我们怎样能过健康的生活？

RawExpression: We need to eat healthy food. We should exercise too.
RawTranslation: 我们需要吃健康的食物。我们还需要运动。

RawExpression: How are you going to spend it?
RawTranslation: 你打算怎么花（这奖励钱）？

RawExpression: I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
I also want to buy some animal books.
RawTranslation: 我还想买一些动物类书籍。

RawExpression: What else are you going to buy?
I'm going to buy a pair of sunglasses for Grandpa.
RawTranslation: 我打算给爷爷买一副太阳镜。

RawExpression: I also want to buy a microscope.
What can you see in the sky?
RawTranslation: 你能在天空中看到什么？

RawExpression: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
RawTranslation: 在晚上，我们能看到月亮和星星。

RawExpression: Is there any water on Mars?
Yes, there is. There is soil too.
I don't think so. They say there aren't any living things.
RawTranslation: 我不这样认为。据说那里没有生物。

RawExpression: China put a rover on Mars.
RawTranslation: 中国在火星上放置了探测器。

RawExpression: The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
RawTranslation: 中国航天员很早就起床。

RawExpression: What do you know about it?
What else do you want to know about water?
RawTranslation: 关于水你还想了解些什么？

RawExpression: Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy.
RawTranslation: 风能、太阳能和水能是不同类型的绿色能源。

RawExpression: But many resources are running out.
RawTranslation: 但是很多资源快要耗尽了。
我们怎样才能节约能源？

RawExpression: We can also use LED lighting.
We should use air conditioners less.
That's the tallest dinosaur in this hall.
RawTranslation: 那是这个大厅里最高的恐龙。

RawExpression: It's taller than both of us together.
What size are your shoes, Mike?
Your feet are bigger than mine. My shoes are size 37.
RawTranslation: 你的脚比我的大。我穿37号的鞋。

RawExpression: I stayed at home with your grandma. We drank tea in the afternoon and watched TV.
RawTranslation: 我和你外婆待在家里。我们喝了下午茶，还看了电视。
你还做了其他什么事吗？

RawExpression: Yes, I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.
RawTranslation: 是的，我打扫了房间，还洗了衣服。

RawExpression: I want to buy the new film magazine.
RawTranslation: 我想买新出的电影杂志。

RawExpression: What did you do last weekend? Did you see a film?
RawTranslation: 你上周末干什么了？你看电影了吗？

RawExpression: No, I had a cold. I stayed at home all weekend and slept.
RawTranslation: 没有，我感冒了。整个周末都待在家里睡觉。

RawExpression: There was no library in my old school.
RawTranslation: 我以前的学校里没有图书馆。

RawExpression: Tell us about your school, please.
RawTranslation: 请给我们讲讲您的学校吧。

RawExpression: There were no computers or Internet in my time.
RawTranslation: 我那时候没有电脑也没有网络。

RawExpression: Before, I was quiet. Now, I'm very active in class.
RawTranslation: 以前我很安静。现在我在课堂上很活跃。

RawExpression: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well. Now, I go cycling every day.
RawTranslation: 我以前个子小，自行车骑得不好。现在我天天骑车。
